page: Microsoft Azure EC32ads_v6 is an x86_64 architecture server instance belonging to the ECadsv6 family. It features 32 dedicated vCPUs powered by an AMD processor and runs on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The instance is equipped with 256.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU.

For local storage, the EC32ads_v6 includes a bundled 1229 GB local SSD. The instance is also Premium Storage capable, allowing for high-throughput external disk attachments. It does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses, meaning networking configurations requiring public ingress must be provisioned separately. No GPU hardware is present on this instance.

From a resource density perspective, this instance offers a high memory-to-vCPU ratio, positioning it as a memory-optimized resource. The inclusion of a large local SSD provides built-in storage capacity, reducing the immediate need for external block storage for temporary files or caching. However, the lack of dedicated GPU accelerators limits its utility for hardware-accelerated machine learning workloads.

The hardware profile of the EC32ads_v6 is structured for memory-intensive applications, database hosting, and enterprise workloads that require substantial RAM and fast local temporary storage. Common deployments include relational databases, in-memory caching layers, and data analytics pipelines.
